label: Town of Winhall
header:
# Town of Winhall municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 28; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a selectboard
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): refers readers to the town's own roster for Winhall
Town of Winhall, Selectboard page (live): E. Stuart Coleman (Chair), Julie Isaacs (Vice Chair), Christie Boswell, Elizabeth Grant, and Stacy Eddy-Gordon

Town of Winhall, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (certified; attested by E. Stuart Coleman and Elizabeth Grant): Christie Boswell elected to a two-year term (99 votes) and Stacy Eddy-Gordon re-elected to a three-year term (99 votes) in 2026
Town of Winhall, 2026 Annual Town Report, officers tables: Coleman (Chair, to 2027), Isaacs (Vice Chair, to 2028), Grant (to 2027); Boswell was first appointed to a vacancy and then elected in 2026
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Elizabeth Grant as Winhall's Town Clerk
Town of Winhall, 2026 Annual Town Report, officers tables: Town Clerk Elizabeth Grant, term to 2028
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Debra Avison as Winhall's Town Treasurer

Town of Winhall, 2026 Annual Town Report, officers tables: the elected officials table lists Town Treasurer Debra Avison, term to 2028; an undated town clerk-directory PDF naming Elizabeth Grant as treasurer is the disclosed outlier
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term
Town of Winhall, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (certified; attested by E. Stuart Coleman and Elizabeth Grant): Scott H. Bushee re-elected Moderator in 2026 (99 votes)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers
Town of Winhall, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (certified; attested by E. Stuart Coleman and Elizabeth Grant): Doug Poulter re-elected Lister in 2026 (99 votes)
Town of Winhall, 2026 Annual Town Report, officers tables: listers Doug Poulter, Alexander Bilka (to 2027), and Lucia Wing (to 2028)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town agent
Town of Winhall, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (certified; attested by E. Stuart Coleman and Elizabeth Grant): Alexander W. Bilka re-elected Town Agent in 2026 (103 votes)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a grand juror
Town of Winhall, Official Return of Votes, March 3, 2026 (certified; attested by E. Stuart Coleman and Elizabeth Grant): Alexander W. Bilka re-elected Grand Juror in 2026 (105 votes)

sources.note: Town of Winhall, 2026 Annual Town Report, officers tables: the appointed officials table lists Collector of Delinquent Taxes Debra Avison (printed term to June 30, 2026; a renewal is unpublished, disclosed). The office is modeled appointed on the town's own table

Town of Winhall, 2026 Annual Town Report, officers tables: the appointed officials table lists Cemetery Commissioner Elizabeth Grant (printed term to June 30, 2026; a renewal is unpublished, disclosed). The town publishes a single appointed seat, so the post carries one seat

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists five Winhall justices of the peace: Timothy Apps, Robin Apps, Christie Boswell, Michael Cole, and Cliff DesMarais

Town of Winhall, 2026 Annual Town Report, officers tables: the town report's JP line prints the third justice 'Christina Boswell'; the certified listing, the certified 2026 return, and the live Selectboard page all give Christie Boswell, which governs
